summary: Ancient Beast is a hex-based, turn-based strategy game built with Phaser. On load it replays a seeded match log to reach a round-8 position. Saved 5 views. (1) battlefield: the hex battlefield mid-match, with creatures, the turn queue, ability buttons and controls. It was saved after only 30 s of replay, and in the check replay the match was still partway through round 8, before the full hex grid and Swampler abilities appear. (2) music-player: overlay with SFX and volume sliders, playlists, track list and supporter marquee. (3) creature-dashboard: opened by clicking a portrait in the queue; shows the roster grid and the Bounty Hunter card with stats and abilities. (4) scoreboard: opened by clicking the player info box at the bottom right. (5) match-setup: the pre-match settings screen, reached by clicking Exit Match twice from the scoreboard. Notes: the in-match controls are not in the accessibility tree, so every click uses x/y coordinates. The 'd' hotkey delays the turn rather than opening the dashboard, and Tab did nothing. Replay timing and outcomes vary a little between runs (one run ended in round 9), so the in-match details may differ slightly.
